title: Juicy Fermented Italian Savoy Cabbage Vitello Tonnato
description: A kosher-friendly Italian dish featuring fermented savoy cabbage and a twist on the classic vitello tonnato, this recipe is a crowd-pleaser. It combines the crunch of fried rice with the tender flavor of fermented cabbage.
instructions: Ferment the savoy cabbage for at least 4 days in a brine solution.
Grind the cooked and dried rice into a coarse crumb.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the ground rice until crispy and golden brown.
Chop the fermented savoy cabbage into small pieces.
Saute the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Combine the fried rice, sauteed onion and garlic, chopped cabbage, capers, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Mix well to combine and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the mixture on a platter or individual plates, garnished with additional capers and lemon wedges if desired.
